name: i2_illusion_break
purpose: Illusion (step I2): Zoroark leads with Ceruledge as its disguise (the last standing member to its right in the party order). Turn 1 the foe Primarina hits it with Moonblast, a damaging move hit: the disguise breaks (replace + -end Illusion) and the holder is shown; Zoroark is then a real Zoroark on the field.
